input.answer: The all-items Consumer Price Index (CPI) for Canada in September 2026 was 170.0 (index, 2002=100, not seasonally adjusted), from Statistics Canada table 18-10-0004. For context, August 2026 was 169.8, so the change was +0.2 index points (170.0 − 169.8 = 0.2), or +0.1% month over month (0.2 / 169.8 × 100 ≈ 0.12%, rounded to 0.1%). Note that the all-items index is published as a level; the percent change above is my own calculation.
